Yes. The appellate court will likely reverse, because the majority (agency) view holds that felony murder does not apply when a co-conspirator is killed by a third person, such as a police officer, during the crime. The fatal shot came from an officer, not from one of the felons in furtherance of the robbery, so that theory does not support a first-degree murder conviction for the woman’s death.

CONFIDENCE: 92
